prompts.east:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the candidate animation sheet to correct. Image 2 is the EXISTING GAME sprite reference, whose slender proportions and small pixel clusters are mandatory. Image 3 is costume reference only. Correct Image1 in TWO concrete ways: (1) replace the entire checkerboard with perfectly flat solid chroma green #00FF00, including every gap inside the bowstring and around limbs; no shadows, textures or checkerboard. (2) EVERY standing pose must be a SLENDER, ADULT, FIVE-TO-SIX-HEADS-TALL ranger as in Image2; current sheet is too squat, large-headed and bulky. Reduce hood relative to body and elongate legs/torso, narrow cape. All 16 frames have the same character anatomy and scale. Preserve bone-white pointed hood, hidden face, rust scarf, thin dark leather armor, brown bow and strapped quiver. Absolutely no chibi, no tiny fat legs, no big boots. Pixel art should read as a 24 pixel wide x 38 pixel tall standing sprite, with 1px details and clean clusters; no painterly gradients.
Keep the exact regular 4 columns x 4 rows of equal-square cells (16 complete silhouettes), no lines or labels or effects. Every standing boot baseline at same relative y per cell; plenty of margin all sides. Same high-oblique top-down camera, facing RIGHT in all cells.
Row1 WALK: explicitly DIFFERENT leg poses: c1 left leg forward/right back stride; c2 both legs passing closely beneath hips with one knee raised; c3 right leg forward/left back stride; c4 opposite leg raised during passing. Cape follows steps but same costume. Need actual walk-cycle articulation not four identical wide stances.
Row2 SHOOT: c1 nock/raise bow; c2 fully draw with rightward arrow; c3 release bowstring and recover drawing hand; c4 lower bow. Row3 c1 low duck dodge; c2 slipping evasive step; c3 low forward dash lunge; c4 recovery. Row4 c1 recoil hit; c2 kneel collapse; c3 falling with one hand down; c4 lying still, no blood. No loose projectile, no shadows, no speech, no letters. Strict flat green background.
prompts.north:
Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is the SELECTED EAST animation sheet: use its exact pixel character appearance, slim proportions, costume, flat chroma green and 4x4 layout. Image 2 is native standing-sprite scale reference. Generate the NORTH-facing counterpart: all 16 poses face straight AWAY from camera toward SCREEN TOP. Not diagonal and never show the black face opening. We see the back of the bone-white pointed hood and long ragged cape, brown crossed straps, back-mounted quiver and red arrow fletching; dark trouser legs and boots. Standing character slender about38 native pixels tall, same scale in all cells. Fixed high-oblique top-down camera. True 1px-detail pixel art, limited flat bone-white/slate/brown/muted rust palette, no gradients or antialias. Pure flat solid #00FF00 background throughout, even inside bowstring, no checkerboard, no shadow, no ground, no text, no dividers.
EXACT FOUR COLUMNS BY FOUR ROWS (16 poses), equal square cells, full body with generous margins, feet groundpoint at same relative baseline. Same scale as selected reference sheet; do not enlarge kneeling or lying poses. Body center stays at same x within each cell, movement in-place.
Row1: four-frame WALK away from us, left foot contact / passing left knee / right foot contact / passing right knee. Alternate both legs visibly, cape edge shifts with stride. Held bow remains at side pointing screen-top.
Row2: four-frame SHOOT straight toward SCREEN TOP: raise+nock, fully draw, release, lower+recover. Back stays facing us; arms extend forward beyond shoulders, bow appears foreshortened HORIZONTAL from rear high angle above shoulders, arrow aims UP along screen y, NEVER SIDEWAYS. Real four distinct articulated poses, not duplicate rotations. No projectile in flight.
Row3: c1 crouch DODGE; c2 evasive slipping step; c3 low forward DASH toward TOP cloak trailing toward bottom; c4 regain stance. Keep north orientation.
Row4: c1 HIT recoil from top; c2 DEATH knees buckle; c3 falling forward to screen top with supporting hand; c4 lying face-down with hood toward screen top and boots toward screen bottom. No blood. 16 different poses, plain green, exact same ranger.
prompts.south:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel sprite animation sheet. Image1 is approved current slim EAST action counterpart, Image2 exact existing native sprite scale. Generate SOUTH-facing counterpart of SAME ranger: faces STRAIGHT toward screen BOTTOM, shoulders frontal symmetric, feet toward bottom. High-oblique fixed camera. Bone-white pointed hood, black face recess (no visible face), small dull-rust scarf, narrow dark-slate armored torso and long slim legs, bone-white ragged cape behind, leather cross-straps/belt/pouches, wooden longbow left hand, quiver red fletching on back. Slender adult five-to-six-head-high proportions, not chunky or chibi. Same anatomy every pose, approximately38px native standing height. Pixel clusters, hard edges, limited palette matching input, no smooth highlights.
Pure perfectly FLAT chroma #00FF00 background, no shadows, no floor, no checkerboard, no labels, no gridlines, no effects. EXACT4columns4rows of equal square cells, 16 whole character silhouettes, same scale all cells and baseline in relative y, generous margin and no touching.
Row1 four WALK-in-place frames facing south: left leg forward contact / passing knee / right leg forward contact / opposite passing knee. Arms and cloth follow walking. Keep bow down at side. Different leg articulation between frames.
Row2 SHOOT toward SCREEN BOTTOM only: c1 raise/nock facing down, c2 full draw bow in front of chest aiming downward foreshortened so bow limbs project LEFT/RIGHT across torso, c3 release toward bottom with hand recovery, c4 lower bow to side. All four face south, no side-facing firing poses, NO projectile drawn. Bow size constant and physically coherent with one curved stave/string held at grip.
Row3 c1 low duck DODGE; c2 slipping step DODGE; c3 forward low DASH facing bottom with cape trailing upward; c4 recover. No roll, no magic.
Row4 c1 HIT recoil torso back; c2 DEATH knees buckle; c3 falling toward bottom one hand supports ground; c4 face-down lying still with hood near bottom boots toward top, same ragged cape/bow in hand, no blood. Never zoom the prone poses. All remain inside equal cells. Flat green only.
prompts.west:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet. Input image1 is matching EAST-facing original; image2 exact native game sprite reference. Generate WEST-facing counterpart: EVERY pose faces SCREEN LEFT, same slender bone-white hooded ranger, same fixed high-oblique top-down angle, same adult proportions, dark hidden face, rust scarf, bone-white ragged cape, slate leather armor, slim legs and brown boots, brown cross-straps and pouches, strapped quiver/red arrow fletching. Respect physical bow left hand and drawing right hand, this is reverse camera view not simple mirror of outfit. Hood/cape/bow NOT redesigned. Use native1px pixel clusters, limited flat bone/slate/brown/rust colors, no soft shading or gradients. Green background exact #00FF00; no checkerboard, no shadow, no ground, no text/gridlines/labels, no VFX.
EXACT4columns4rows 16 complete poses in identical square cells, generous margin, baseline consistent within each cell. Slender38px standing sprite when downscaled, identical body scale in all cells even low poses.
ROW1 WALK left in place: left foot forward contact, passing knee, right foot forward contact, opposite passing knee. Actually change leg articulation (passing silhouettes narrow), not identical posed feet. Bow held low pointing left in every walk frame, cape trails right.
ROW2 SHOOT LEFT: raise+nock; full draw with bow arm extended LEFT and drawing hand at face, arrow tip LEFT; release with relaxed string hand; lower+recover. Show opposite side from east sheet and the bow stays left of torso. No projectile in flight.
ROW3 c1 DODGE duck low leftward; c2 evasion slipping step leftward; c3 DASH low lunge toward LEFT cloak streaming behind to right; c4 regained running stance leftward. No magic or rolling.
ROW4 c1 HIT torso recoil; c2 DEATH kneel buckle; c3 collapse leftwards one hand supporting; c4 lying still hood toward LEFT with cape/boots to right and bow near hand. No blood. Never enlarge or shrink body between frames. Distinct poses consistent costume/pixel material.
